_note: Blessed ranking snapshot for the rank-stability probe (crates/b2-embed/examples/stability.rs, GH #141): the top-10 notes and chunks each probe in stability.json returns from fixtures/test-vault under the deterministic fake embedder. Committed so a later run can show *movement* — any ranking change (candidate width, the RRF constant, chunking, resolution) shows up here as drift rather than being inferred. It scores nothing: the corpus is unlabelled, so drift means different, never worse. Regenerate with `just stability-bless` once a ranking change is the intended one.
